title: Create Your First Note
description: Learn how to create and save your first note in Notention

steps.title: Open Quick Capture
steps.description: Press Ctrl+N or click the + button to open the quick capture dialog

steps.title: Enter Note Content
steps.description: Type your note content in the editor

steps.title: Save the Note
steps.description: Press Ctrl+Enter or click Save to create the note

steps.title: Note Created
steps.description: Verify the note appears in the notes list
